verdict.rationale: The alerting half is documented: Trigger.dev sends alerts by email, Slack and webhooks when tasks fail, and it has a real-time trace and log view in its own dashboard. Nothing in the evidence shows failure rates, latencies or queue depths being exported to an external observability stack. The management API's runs.list is the only programmatic route to run data, which would need custom work to turn into metrics. Missing for 10: metrics export (OpenTelemetry/Prometheus/Datadog), queue-depth and latency metrics, alerts on conditions beyond task failure, independent corroboration.
